description: Crash Map - WA is an interactive resource (dashboard, viewer or map) listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Road Safety Data (National Road Safety Hub) group, published by Main Roads, WA. The Crash Map system enables users to perform macro and micro analyses of reported road crashes in WA. The crash data is available to State and Local Government road asset managers. Crash Map also provides a fully integrated platform for the creation and management of applications for the State and Federal Black Spot Program in WA. Coverage is Western Australia; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as not stated, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2024-08-01. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is not stated in the catalogue entry (source page not read). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support road incident and emergency response analysis and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
